notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
Patch 1.2. Thank you so much for your feedback and bug reports!


 Fixed Japanese localization issue
 Fixed a few "look at" triggers not working sometimes on different resolution monitors

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Patch 1.1. Thank you so much for your feedback and bug reports!


 Burial spot icon on map added
 Objective is clearer for burial spot
 Improved hint notification when stuffed animal puzzle is solved
 Improved tub puzzle key collider making it easier to pick up

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.5
notes.notes:
Demo patch 1.5. Thank you so much for your feedback and bug reports!

- Improved the physics of destructibles
- Further improvements on Willie's AI
- The player now starts with the flashlight and batteries are no longer needed!

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.4
notes.notes:
Demo patch 1.4. Thank you so much for your feedback and bug reports!

- Fixed a bug where Willie's movements and speed would bug out under higher and variable framerates
- Optimized game so fewer physics calls are run every frame
- Increased the volume and hearing range of destructibles

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.3
notes.notes:
Demo patch 1.3. Thank you so much for your feedback and bug reports!


 Improved Willie’s AI
 Willie can now “vanish” obstacles temporarily, to reach the player
 Changed and optimized Willie’s teleport animation
 Improved performance and optimized level to improve frame rates in certain areas
 Updated UI to release version’s UI

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
Demo patch 1.2. Thank you so much for your feedback and bug reports!


 Fixed issue with Japanese, Chinese, and Korean characters appearing blank or empty
 Fixed a bug where upon loading a game, completed objective triggers would trigger again, even if the player has already seen them
 Fixed footstep sounds sometimes not triggering the right sound in 35 Nicole
 Fixed master bedroom drawer in 48 Fairview not opening
 Fixed locked toolbox hint message from accidentally revealing the location of the key
 Added a visual cue to press Play after inserting a VHS tape

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
First demo patch. Thank you so much for your feedback and bug reports!

- Added option to load last save on death
- Fixed bug where placeholder saves were shown in load screen
- Improved shadow quality from the flashlight
- Increased volume of "puzzle incorrect" notification
- Fixed a bug where "Find safe code" would not be marked as completed
